pairs.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/ardy/pof_bvh_blender.py:100 The headless Blender stage writes a skinned proxy and animation FBX for UE, then reports OK on the exporter's return alone; it never re-reads the file to confirm the armature, the mesh and the clip are present, which is the self-certified delivery the technique exists to remove.

techniques.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/ardy/pof_bvh_blender.py:91 The export is scoped with use_selection, but no read-back of objects or clips follows before the OK marker at line 100.
scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_critique.py:1 The critique only measures structure (watertight, components, bbox); no reduce or unwrap stage exists in this context.

pairs.subject: mesh-finishing-for-engine-readiness
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/BlenderPipelineView/FBXConversionTab.tsx:38 The FBX to GLB receipt shows mesh and triangle counts the script measured from the scene BEFORE export (pof_fbx_convert.py), and the route only checks that the file exists and is fresh.
